_selector_roles: sidebar_row = the CONTAINER queried with querySelectorAll; it is the node whose own `id` attribute carries the conversation id. sidebar_item = a CHILD of that row holding the display name (falls back to the row itself). Do not swap these — the rail reads the id off sidebar_row.

notes.sidebar_enumeration: Prefer [data-qa="virtual-list-item"] and read the conversation id off the element's id attribute — [role="treeitem"] carries the label but not always the id. NEVER dump raw element attributes: they can contain session data and the extraction layer will refuse the whole payload.
notes.sidebar_click_unreliable: Clicking a sidebar row does NOT navigate reliably. Extract the conversation id and navigate directly to https://app.slack.com/client/<TEAM_ID>/<CONV_ID>.
notes.date_divider_artifact: Sidebar enumeration also returns rows whose id equals the CURRENTLY OPEN conversation with labels like 'Tuesday August 4th' — these are message date dividers in the main pane, not conversations. Dedupe by id and drop labels matching /^(Yesterday|Today|(Mon|Tues|Wednes|Thurs|Fri|Satur|Sun)day )/.
notes.virtual_list: The sidebar is virtualised — only rendered rows are in the DOM. Collapsed sections (esp. Direct messages) hide conversations. What is enumerated is a floor, not the complete set.
notes.direction: sender_name == 'Abhijeet Gandhi' (or an OWNER_IDENTITY) => outbound; otherwise inbound. Capture BOTH — a rail that only sees inbound cannot tell we already replied.
notes.signin_detection: After navigation, if location.href matches /signin|get-started|\/ssb\// the session is dead — FAIL LOUD with 'log into <workspace> in Chrome', never return 0 silently.

cmf-publishing.note: Small workspace — one channel plus Slackbot. DM section was collapsed at enumeration time; re-enumerate with sections expanded if coverage looks thin.
